results.label: the backup is served and carries the practice bundle with its three keys, exactly as M108 left it
the export gains no ask/channel/answer key of any kind: the channel stores nothing to back up
the export carries no model, key, transcript or session id from the channel either
a well-formed practice archive still imports through the unchanged path
an archive dated today can be restored too, and is still labelled an archive
an imported archive for today is counted separately and never as the trader’s own recorded session
the channel’s line for the archive says it is never this account’s recorded session rather than leaving it to inference
the practice surface itself still counts the archive separately, so the channel and the surface agree on the same numbers
the channel never reports an imported archive as having verified anything
an unknown bundle key is not imported at all: a crafted ask/answers payload cannot be restored into authority
a crafted bundle changes nothing about a live refusal: the same question still refuses for the same reason
a crafted bundle cannot make the channel report a permission, a pass or a limit change: no grant-shaped field exists in the payload at all
a restored gate record arrives as an imported archive and cannot become this desk’s own answered gate
a second trader importing the same bundle is reported with their own empty day, not the first trader’s records
and their export still carries only their own records
deleting a trader still removes their archives with them, and the channel then reports that workspace as gone rather than answering for it

scope: M109 backup, restore and the advisory channel: actual runtime/auth/SQL/DOM on literal journals, fixedUTC; deterministic read-only advisory channel, no model/network/provider/broker/mental-state/pixel/production proof
